title: A murder
content: Last night in Mall world I was in the white four-story buildings that look like barracks dorms. I know some of you understand what I'm talking about. I'm not sure who it was but I killed someone. With a gun. The security was looking for me everywhere. I hid it in a dumpster. And then the strangest thing happened. A glowing UFO appeared. That has never happened EVER. It was a bluish whitish light that almost blended in with the sky. Everyone around me was having the same reactions but they were talking to each other in a way that suggests they were all having their own experiences separate to mine. If you've seen me running from the security in the building or if you saw that UFO last night, please let me know.
